messages:
jamie_ts: Running into a pnpm/monorepo weirdness with the JS SDK and edge sample app. Works when I run from packages/sdk, but when the app depends on it via workspace the edge bundler (esbuild in Vercel preview) can't resolve '@redwood/sdk' (ModuleNotFound). Anyone seen this pattern?

sara_devex: Yup. Usually an exports map + pnpm symlink mismatch. Bundlers in edge mode sometimes don't resolve package exports the same way Node does, especially with hoisted deps.

anil_eng: Can you paste the package.json exports from the SDK? If it's only exposing import/require to dist entrypoints, tools that need package.json or subpaths will fail. Example problematic form: 
"exports": {"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"}

jamie_ts: Real snippet: {"name":"@redwood/sdk","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"}
Error log: Could not resolve "@redwood/sdk" from /workspace/apps/sample/src/main.ts

mike_r: Short fixes: 1) add "./package.json":"./package.json" to exports so bundlers can read metadata, 2) add wildcard exports like "./*": "./dist/*", or 3) add a tiny root proxy file that re-exports dist for edge consumers.

sara_devex: We solve similar by conditional exports for edge vs node: 
"exports": {"import": {"edge":"./dist/edge.mjs","default":"./dist/index.mjs"},"require":"./dist/index.cjs","./package.json":"./package.json"}
That gives bundlers a clear edge entrypoint.

anil_eng: Also note TypeScript complaining often: "Could not find declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk'" when using pnpm workspaces. Make sure package.json 'types' points to dist and consider typesVersions if folder layout diverges.

ci-bot: Build snippet: TS2307: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk'. package.json types -> dist/index.d.ts exists in package but not resolved from app root.

mike_r: For local dev we add a postinstall helper that writes a root index.mjs re-exporting dist so bundlers/tsserver can see it. Ugly but catches issues: node scripts/ensure-dist.js writes "export * from './dist/index.mjs'" into index.mjs.

sara_devex: Important: edge bundlers can tree-shake side-effectful modules. If auth/patch-fetch is imported indirectly in node entry, bundler may drop it. Add explicit import in edge.mjs like `import './auth/patch-fetch.js'` or mark sideEffects in package.json.

jamie_ts: That explains auth tokens not refreshing only in Vercel previews. Thought it was creds.

mike_r: Actionable checklist: add ./package.json export, provide edge conditional export, expose wildcard subpaths if needed, ensure types visible from workspace root, add a smoke CI step that builds sample app from repo root (`pnpm --filter apps/sample build`).

sara_devex: I'll draft a short devex doc with packaging checklist for monorepos (exports, types, edge conditional, postinstall fallback).

jamie_ts: Thanks all 44d I'll open a tiny PR with conditional exports + package.json export and note in sample app README.
